description: This file defines classes and constants for handling x86 architecture-specific debugging and exception handling within a GDB stub implementation, including register definitions, exception vectors, and signal mapping.

classes.name: RegNum
classes.description: Defines register number constants matching the i386 register enum in GDB.

classes.name: ExceptionVectors
classes.description: Defines exception vector constants matching kernel architecture data.

classes.name: GdbStub_x86
classes.description: Implements architecture-specific GDB stub functionalities for x86, including parsing architecture data, signal computation, and register packet handling.

methods.name: parse_arch_data_block
methods.description: Unpacks architecture data from logfile and initializes register states and exception info.

methods.name: compute_signal
methods.description: Maps exception vector to GDB signal number.

methods.name: handle_register_group_read_packet
methods.description: Generates a GDB packet with register values in hex format.

methods.name: handle_register_single_read_packet
methods.description: Responds with placeholder data for a single register read.
